scoring_justification: PDOS peak positions are recomputed from the raw CSV; structure and properties are compared to paper gold as those are the only artifacts.

outputs.description: Bond lengths and angles from the optimized CoPc geometry, compared to hidden reference values with tolerances.
HOMO-LUMO gap and magnetic moments from the GGA+U calculation, compared to hidden reference values with tolerances.
Co 3d projected density of states; peak positions are computed from the data and compared to hidden reference peaks with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are compared to the paper-reported values with predefined tolerances. The PDOS file is required to contain the energy grid and corresponding Co-d projected DOS; the checker will identify local maxima and compare their positions.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference bond lengths and angles (GGA+U, U=6 eV) from Table 1
hidden_assets.generation_method: copied directly from the published table
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper's own reported results for the same quantity and conditions

hidden_assets.purpose: reference HOMO-LUMO gap, total magnetic moment, Co magnetic moment
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: HOMO-LUMO gap 1.4 eV, total moment 1 μB, Co moment 1.04 μB
hidden_assets.generation_method: copied from the paper's description of GGA+U (U=6 eV) results

hidden_assets.purpose: reference Co-d PDOS peak positions for the two prominent peaks near HOMO
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Fig. 3c of the paper (GGA+U, U=6 eV Co-d PDOS) and text mention of sharp peak at -1.7 eV and second prominent peak
hidden_assets.generation_method: visual extraction from the published figure; estimated positions -1.7 and -2.6 eV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: consistent with the text and with the reference solver's synthetic data that reproduces the expected DOS features

steps.description: Find local maxima in Co 3d PDOS within -5..+2 eV and check that peaks at positions near reference peaks exist.
